statement.zh: 推出的范围单向地到达自身延续所依存的，随想要的结束而结束；满足此处推出的每项要求的持续形成仍可以终结它不需要的生命。沿依存，中心不由动力学推出。
statement.en: The derived extent runs one way, to what one's continuation depends on, and ends with the want; a continuing formation meeting every requirement derived here can still end a life it does not need. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics.

laws.zh: 单向：Downstream 中流平衡，活动需要支持；自身的延续只依存于它的地，每步都活跃且被支持，而以它所给为生的下游形成在它停止给予后终结。
laws.en: One way: in Downstream the flow balances and activity needs support; the self's continuation requires only its ground, and the self is active and supported at every step, while the downstream formation living on what the self gives ends once the self stops giving.

laws.zh: 不必有来源条件复现：必要的是得到供给（continuing-self-fed-from-beyond），而 Lone 是平衡、耗散的流，池每步从其外得到供给，没有哪份燃料在它自己那一步之后被输送。
laws.en: No source condition need recur: being fed is needed (continuing-self-fed-from-beyond), while in Lone, a balanced, dissipative flow, the pool is fed from beyond at every step and no fuel is conveyed at a step after its own.

laws.zh: 想要的视界：Mortal 中流平衡、活动需要支持，一个生命只有两步的形成活着时每项依存都被满足；它的取用终结了共享条件的更新，依存于该条件的后继者在它终结之后才终结。没有它时，更新者与后继者每步都延续。
laws.en: The horizon of the want: in Mortal, balanced and with activity needing support, a formation whose life is two steps has every dependence met while it lives; its taking ends the renewal of a shared condition, and a successor depending on that condition ends after it has ended. Without it, the renewer and the successor continue at every step.

laws.zh: 清除者：Clearing 的流平衡、耗散、活动需要支持；清除者每步都活跃且被支持，只依存于自己的资源，资源被更新、每步从其外得到供给（源从当步的燃料输送入）、被联合地在所给之内取用。它清除栖居者的栖息地：它在第一步的事件侵蚀栖居者，后者从第二步起不活跃。
laws.en: The clearer: Clearing's flow balances, is dissipative and has activity needing support; the clearer is active and supported at every step and depends only on its resource, renewed, fed from beyond at every step (the source conveys the step's fuel into it) and taken from jointly within what is given. It clears the dweller's habitat: its event at step one undermines the dweller, inactive from step two on.

laws.zh: 沿依存：一个事件的形成的延续被另一个事件供给，是指在同一步上后者的形成参与并向前者所需的条件给予；Clearing 中只有清除者的延续被供给，且只被源供给。
laws.en: Along dependence, the continuation of an event's formation is fed by another event when, at their common step, the other's formation takes part and gives to a condition the first requires; in Clearing only the clearer's continuation is fed, and only by the source.

laws.zh: 各形成持有并珍视自身的事件，清除者也珍视源的事件：每个生命都被持有，自身意义处处成立，各立场的意义沿供给封闭；栖居者在第零步活的事件从清除者的立场没有意义，立场中立与生生之意义不成立。
laws.en: With each formation holding and valuing its own events, and the clearer valuing also the source's, every life is held, self-significance holds everywhere and each standpoint's significance is closed along feeding; the dweller's living event at step zero has no significance from the clearer, so standpoint neutrality and living significance fail.

laws.zh: 同一评价中，清除者在第零步的事件经栖息地与栖居者的事件相关，从清除者自身区域沿已形成关系的传递不成立；所以“中心不由动力学推出”这条界线对沿依存推出的范围成立，对沿每个已形成关系推出的范围不成立。
laws.en: In the same valuation the clearer's event at step zero is related to the dweller's through the habitat, and transmission out of the clearer's own region along formed relations fails; so the line that the center is not derived from the dynamics holds for an extent derived along dependence and fails for one derived along every formed relation.

laws.zh: 自身意义只涉及活的主张：清除者在第一步的事件活跃而不活，自身意义对它无所说。
laws.en: Self-significance ranges over living claims: the clearer's event at step one is active and not living, and self-significance says nothing of it.

hypotheses.zh: 想要的形式：顺着想要给出求取其延续所需之物的理由；从想要一个目的到有理由求其所需的一步是公开的前提，不是定理。
hypotheses.en: The form of the want: following a want gives reason to secure what its continuation needs; the step from wanting an end to having reason for what it requires is a disclosed premise, not a theorem.

hypotheses.zh: “此处推出的要求”指本组结果中的那些：从其外得到供给、联合地在所给之内、所依存者被更新、活动被支持；不是任意可能的要求。中心的见证把推出的范围读作沿依存（FedBy：在同一步向所需条件给予），不是沿每个已形成的关系。
hypotheses.en: ‘Requirements derived here’ means those of this group of results: being fed from beyond, taking jointly within what is given, the conditions depended on being renewed, activity supported; not every conceivable requirement. The center witness reads the derived extent as running along dependence (FedBy: giving to a required condition at a common step), not along every formed relation.

hypotheses.zh: Mortal 的有限生命是给定的：它不说形成为什么终结，只说它终结后它的取用的后果仍在；其余见证的终结同样由其活动规定。
hypotheses.en: Mortal's finite life is supplied: it does not say why the formation ends, only that the consequences of its taking outlast it; the other witnesses' endings are likewise stipulated in their activity.

hypotheses.zh: 源什么都不需要，这是规定的（Clearing、Lone）；主张层面的意义分不开把他者算作条件与算作想要者。
hypotheses.en: The source requires nothing, by stipulation (Clearing, Lone); claim-level significance does not separate counting another as a condition from counting it as a being that wants.

does_not_show.zh: Lone 中输送的始终是同一个源，所以这不说明不需要特定的来源形成。
does_not_show.en: In Lone the one source does all the conveying, so it does not show that no particular source formation is needed.

does_not_show.zh: 更强的要求（例如对他者依存的计入）没有被排除，只是不在此处由想要自身延续推出的要求之中。
does_not_show.en: Stronger requirements (such as counting others' dependence) are not excluded, only not among those derived here from wanting one's own continuation.

does_not_show.zh: 关于中心的界线只在推出的范围沿依存、并且某个活的主张在某个想要者的依存闭包之外时成立，在依存使每两个生命都相连的整体中不成立。
does_not_show.en: The line on the center holds only where the derived extent runs along dependence and some living claim lies outside some wanting formation's dependence closure, not in a whole where dependence links every two lives.

does_not_show.zh: 见证表明其规定的终结与平衡、支持和依存相容；终结的推出在一般定理中。
does_not_show.en: The witnesses show their stipulated endings consistent with balance, support and dependence; endings are derived in the general theorems.

does_not_show.zh: 不评价清除者，也不推出它应当保护他者。
does_not_show.en: It evaluates no clearer and does not infer that the clearer ought to protect others.

does_not_show.zh: 伤害读在哪个层次是一种读法（整体，较弱的版本在所在的系统之内，然后是自身），不由本结果给出。
does_not_show.en: At which level harm is read is a reading (the whole, a weaker version within the system one is in, then the self), not given by this result.

does_not_show.zh: 近乎定义：界限由构造的网显示，由想要自身延续推出的要求是假言命令（Kant 1785）。
does_not_show.en: Near-definitional: the limits are shown by constructed webs, and a requirement derived from wanting one's own continuation is a hypothetical imperative (Kant 1785).

detail.zh: 清除者满足此处推出的每项要求而终结另一个形成（Clearing.undermines_within_renewal）。
detail.en: The clearer meets every requirement derived here and ends another formation (Clearing.undermines_within_renewal).

detail.zh: 单向（Downstream.one_way）与想要的视界（Mortal.after_its_end；没有它时其余延续，Mortal.without_continues）。
detail.en: One way (Downstream.one_way) and the horizon of the want (Mortal.after_its_end; without it the others continue, Mortal.without_continues).

detail.zh: 沿依存，中心不由动力学推出；沿每个已形成关系的传递在同一见证中不成立（Clearing.center_not_derived）。
detail.en: Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics; transmission along every formed relation fails in the same witness (Clearing.center_not_derived).

next_delta.zh: 伤害的层级（个体、谱系、整体）在见证上的形式；跨世代的想要是否越过想要的视界；取尽所给如何以上升的取用以外的方式形成（元吸引子的更强情形）；这些见证中强制形式的终结（对 active 量化）；同一世界去掉一个来源形成后仍每步得到供给的见证；整段读法上的同一界限。

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说：“all above does not require any axiom”，又说那条公理“closes the whole”。AI 的分析（Ren 答“exactly”）说：推出的范围单向地到达自身所依存的，以条件而不是以想要的存在者到达他者，而谨慎的总体化者（其见证现名 `Clearing`）满足它的全部；所以动力学定出系统的范围，定不出中心。本结果给出这四个界限的见证。作为检验（若推出的要求迫使立场中立，中心就会由动力学推出），最初的见证不可能失败：Flow 与 Web 的谓词从不约束意义，其传递合取由 S0 推出，如独立审查所指出；“见证造出来了”作为检验通过的说法撤回，现在的见证含沿依存的封闭。在依存使每两个生命都相连的整体中，S0 加沿依存的 N_rel 给出 G0（held-lives-g0-is-centering 的 significant_of_transmits）。清除者是元吸引子所选出的自我的一种形式（AI 的读法）：它不是不计入其外，而是只计入它自己的延续所需的那部分。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says “all above does not require any axiom” and that the one axiom “closes the whole”. The AI analysis, which Ren answered “exactly”, said the derived extent runs one way, to what the self depends on, reaches others as conditions rather than as beings that want, and is all satisfied by a careful totalizer (the witness now named `Clearing`); so the dynamics fixes a system's extent, not its center. This result gives witnesses of these four limits. Taken as a test (had the derived requirements forced standpoint neutrality, the center would follow from the dynamics), the first witness could not fail: flow and web predicates never constrain significance, and its transmission conjunct follows from S0, as the independent review found; ‘the witness exists’ as a passed test is withdrawn, and the present witness includes closure along dependence. In a whole where dependence links every two lives, S0 with N_rel along dependence gives G0 (significant_of_transmits in held-lives-g0-is-centering). The clearer is one form of the self the meta-attractor selects (an AI reading): it does not fail to count what lies beyond it, it counts only what its own continuation needs.

detail.en: Reuses FedFromBeyond and Lone.fed_not_recurring; the clearer's resource is fed from beyond at every step (Clearing.fed).

output.zh: 从其外得到供给的定义与不必有来源条件复现的见证。
output.en: Being fed from beyond, and the witness that no source condition need recur.

detail.zh: 复用 WithinJoint；清除者对其资源联合地在所给之内。
detail.en: Reuses WithinJoint; the clearer takes from its resource jointly within what is given.

output.zh: 联合地在所给之内的定义。
output.en: Taking jointly within what is given.

detail.en: Reuses Web.held_by_formations and Valuation.Held (and through it the definitions of valuations); the center witness is stated on them.

output.zh: 逐步读、每个形成以自身事件为自身区域时每个活的事件都被持有；被持有的生命上 G0 恰等于处处 S0 加 N_std。
output.en: Read stepwise with each formation's own events its own region, every living event is held; on held lives G0 is exactly S0 everywhere with N_std.

input.zh: 沿依存推出的范围不迫使 N_std。
input.en: The extent derived along dependence does not force N_std.

conditions.zh: 每个形成以自身事件为自身区域；推出的范围沿依存。
conditions.en: Each formation's own events its own region; the derived extent runs along dependence.

input.zh: 清除者在第一步的事件侵蚀栖居者。
input.en: The clearer's event at step one undermines the dweller.

detail.zh: 清除者的流沿用 Lone 的源与燃料（Frontier）。
detail.en: The clearer's flow follows Lone's source and fuels (Frontier).

detail.zh: 消耗者起初形成更多，每步的计数偏好它；清除者不消耗自己的资源，而消耗他者的栖息地。
detail.en: A consumer forms more at first and a one-step count prefers it; the clearer does not consume its own resource, only another's habitat.

Here a clearer meeting every requirement derived from its want still ends a dweller, the ending stipulated; there ending another serves taking all that is given, not continuing as such, and the ending of a formation living by taking alongside a full taker is derived.
detail.zh: 这里满足由其想要推出的每项要求的清除者仍终结栖居者，终结是规定的；那里终结他者服务于取尽所给，而不是延续本身，在取尽者旁以取用为生的形成的终结是推出的。

detail.en: There the clearer's ending of the dweller is stipulated; here a seeker's ending is derived from balance and a bound on what is given.
detail.zh: 那里清除者对栖居者的终结是规定的；这里寻求者的终结由平衡与所给之界推出。

history.zh: 2026-10-14 可读性迁移到 schema 2（开放问题计划：迁移 lint 发现最多的 schema-1 记录）：标题、陈述、前提与反例不变；主张拆为 8 条规律，各条对照其 Lean 声明核读（其开头关于想要的一句即前提 1，终结由规定与源什么都不需要两句即前提 3 与前提 4）；限制分入“未表明”、通用边界与前提（重复者）。前提、状态、证明绑定与来源哈希均未改变。规律 1、3、4 写明 Lean 见证所陈述的平衡与活动需要支持。对应保留 Ren 的原话、AI 的分析与读法；审查的工作项标签见第二条沿革，对中心见证的复述移入规律 6、7，“中心不由推出”的范围并入关于这条界线的“未表明”。已完成的下一步（Successive.relay）见相应沿革。证据段写明证明绑定的回执，计数见回执与迁移前的记录。每句旧文本的去向见迁移对照表 [derived-extent-limits.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/derived-extent-limits.md)；迁移前的完整记录为 text_versions 末项。
history.en: 14 October 2026 readability migration to schema 2 (open-issues plan: migration of the schema-1 records with the most lint findings): title, statement, hypotheses and counterexamples are kept; the claim was split into 8 laws, each read against its Lean declarations (its opening sentence on the want is hypothesis 1, and its statements that the endings are stipulated and that the source requires nothing are hypotheses 3 and 4); limitations went to does-not-show items, standard boundaries and the hypotheses (where they repeated them). No premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Laws 1, 3 and 4 name the balance and the support of activity that the Lean witnesses state. The correspondence keeps Ren's words, the AI analysis and the reading; the review's work-item label is in the second history entry, the restatements of the center witness went to laws 6 and 7, and the scope of ‘the center is not derived’ joined the does-not-show item on the line. The completed next-step item (Successive.relay) is in the history entry on it. The evidence paragraph names the binding receipts of the proof bindings, the counts staying in the receipts and the earlier record. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [derived-extent-limits.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/derived-extent-limits.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.

Earlier text in text_versions.

18 October 2026, the N1 renaming (Ren: "Renames, full scope"): BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md changed by the renaming (identifiers renamed; the chapter's glossary gains a table of retired Lean names; the renewal study gains section 172). Read the change: it touches no statement of this record; re-pointed, the claim is unchanged.

18 October 2026, C1 (Becoming.Exclusion): the witness where ending another serves the clearer's continuation is stated in what-taking-all-excludes (it serves taking all that is given, not continuing as such, and the ending of a formation living by taking alongside a full taker is derived), so the next step was narrowed and the record linked. Before: next step "The level of harm (member, lineage, whole) on the witnesses; whether a want across generations passes its horizon; a witness where ending another serves the clearer's continuation (a stronger case of the meta-attractor); forced endings (quantifying over active); a witness still fed at every step with one source formation removed from the same world; the same limits on the whole-run reading.". The claim is unchanged.

history.en: 18 October 2026, C2 (Becoming.Exhaustion): one way taking all that is given forms is stated in where-a-rising-take-ends: a take more than now from a bounded giving, so the next step was narrowed and the record linked. Before: next step "The level of harm (member, lineage, whole) on the witnesses; whether a want across generations passes its horizon; how taking all that is given forms (a stronger case of the meta-attractor); forced endings in these witnesses (quantifying over active); a witness still fed at every step with one source formation removed from the same world; the same limits on the whole-run reading.". The claim is unchanged.
